messages:
Marta: FYI got a spike alert: $9.6k GPU charge landed on `unlabeled-sandbox` for project demo-acme-2026. Looks like a customer demo run spilled into central sandbox.
BillingBot: Alert: GPU anomaly detected. project=demo-acme-2026, delta=$9,612. Created ticket FIN-10012.
Tom: quick BQ: `SELECT project_id, labels, cost FROM billing_export WHERE project_id='demo-acme-2026' AND invoice_month=CURRENT_DATE()` -> labels: none for customer_id or sales_deal. owner=solutions-eng.
Jules (Sales): That demo was for ACME POC. If we can bill it back to the ACME POC line item we should. Do we have an MSA/expense pass-through?
Priyanka: Two options: 1) reclassify to Sales demo expense (GL 6205) and absorb cost, 2) issue invoice/credit to customer if contract permits. For speed, finance prefers reclassify unless Sales confirms customer should be billed.
Sandeep: What's the demo SLA / was this an on-demand customer workload or internal test? Need engineering confirmation before we decide.
Marta: Confirmed with Eng: Solutions team ran a long multi-model benchmark during the demo which caused the spike. It was visible in their pager logs. Owner: @Liam (solutions-eng).
Tom: Root cause: automation that spins demo clusters doesn't apply `customer_id` label when run in sandbox. I pushed a small helper: enforce label at create time and a gitops check: `scripts/ci/check-demo-labels.sh`. PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/4210
Priyanka: Ok. For FIN-10012 we'll mark pending: "awaiting_sales_decision". Jules, can Sales confirm whether ACME should be invoiced? If yes, attach PO # and we'll route to billing. If no, we'll post as Sales Demo expense GL 6205.
Jules (Sales): Checking contract and PO. If ACME accepts demo usage as billable we'll invoice. ETA 24h.
Sandeep: Finance pre-approves temporary charge to Sales Demo budget (GL 6205) pending Jules. Please include note: "subject to customer billing confirmation; potential reclass to revenue if invoiced."
BillingBot: FIN-10012 updated: status=pending_sales_response. Reminder: nightly tag-backfill job available for historical attribution if needed.
Marta: Uploaded cost slice CSV: /finance/gpu-transfers/1925006789-demo-acme-usage.csv and added PR link. Also created a monitoring rule to alert if any demo project lacks customer_id label.
Tom: Added automated rollback to ensure demo runs don't exceed 8 GPU hrs without explicit billing label. :white_check_mark:
Priyanka: Closing checklist: csv, PR, eng owner email, sales confirmation or invoice. Once resolution, finance will backfill showback and charge or absorb accordingly.
Jules (Sales): Update: ACME wants to be invoiced for excess demo usage. PO# ACME-PO-9001 attached to FIN-10012. Please route to AR.
Priyanka: Received PO. We'll prepare an invoice and reclass Journal to revenue code GL 4107 and reverse the temporary GL 6205 if already posted. Will update FIN-10012 when invoice created.
Marta: Thanks everyone — leaving notes here for audit.
